protocol.question: At equal support size, how do collected states compare with uniformly sampled states?

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.sampling: uniform distinct local support positions mapped to global rows
optimizer.target_update_timing: after every optimizer step in both arms

gates.scope: each seed, final greedy; fresh above pooled random

collection.smoke_source: synthetic fixture: sorted every-third row on alternate banks; no collection

support_selection.successor_access: full training bank, detached; outside-support successors never enter current-state support

resource_limits.check_cadence: each collection step, each optimizer update, each evaluation layout, phase boundaries and after aggregation; sampled stop guard

limitations: Both arms retain privileged all-action transitions and full-bank detached successor queries; this is not trajectory-only online RL.
Equal cardinality controls support size but not map/clock composition, graph connectivity or induced sampling distribution.
One archived collected bank and one uniform subset are shared by three learner initializations; these are not independent support replications.
Own-support and outside-support diagnostics do not alter the full-bank or fresh-behavior gates.

per_condition.goal_near_definition: shortest-path distance at most 2 moves, all remaining clocks

successor_queries.denominator: all four nonterminal transitions from unique supported current states, before training

per_condition.semantics: support membership; visited_* field names denote inclusion, not new trajectory visits

paired_differences.scope: final greedy, matched seed and layout

support_diagnostics.classification: declared descriptive diagnostic; not a gate
support_diagnostics.scope: final saved dense predictions on each arm's own current-state support and its full-training-bank complement
support_diagnostics.agreement_denominator: winnable states only; exact action regret <=1e-6, rtol0
support_diagnostics.error_denominator: all four actions and all states, including deadline-impossible states
support_diagnostics.pooled_denominator: shared states repeated across learner initializations, not independent task banks
